definition: [ דֶּ֫מַע ] noun [masculine] (weeping, trickling) juice , i.e. wine or (&) oil (compare following) דִּמְעֲךָ Exod 22:28 (|| מְלֵאָֽתְךָ ), compare Di ; Arabic = wine.
